'''Power Control Modules''' were components manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use in [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]]. Six hundred units were transported on [[Santhe Passenger and Freight]]'s [[SPF 14897]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TT">{{WEGCite|story=The Trap (adventure scenario)|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref>
